data.body: Fixed by Gerrit 3395, merged 2026-11-13 12:04 PST as 66473a714766199127da3272e1a536f5f8a14b82 (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, 0 unresolved). Implementation note: a MERGED change also counts as success when --revision is among its patch sets, re-read with o=ALL_REVISIONS, because Rebase-If-Necessary may merge a newer patch set. This mirrors the existing reconcile path. Evidence: 4 new tests in tests/unit/test_gerrit_submit_if_current_8b1c.py (36 pass); make verify exit 0 (21275 + 218 passed). Live read-only checks against change 3393: the merged revision prints "change 3393 is already merged at aa1681bb…; nothing to submit" and exits 0; a wrong revision prints "MERGED at aa1681bb…, not at the inspected revision 0000…; nothing submitted" and exits 2.
